headline: Incentives and competition will define the scope of the Digital Economy Law: experts
summary: The law empowers the tax authority Hacienda to determine strategic sectors where electronic payment means could become the only accepted form of payment. Experts say incentives and competition will shape its reach.
why: Payment rules affect fintech, banks and payment processors, so the scope of Mexico's digital economy law matters to investors in those businesses.
original_headline: Incentivos y competencia definirán alcance de la Ley de Economía Digital: expertos
